Yash Maheshwari Chhath Sindoor Joke Row: bihar men komediyan yash maheshvari ki tippani ko lekar vivad gahrata ja raha hai. chhath mahaparv aur mahilaon ke sindur ko lekar ki gaee kathit abhadr tippani par rajnitik dalon ne kari narajgi jataee hai. bijepi, aarjedi, jediyu aur kangres ne is tippani par aapatti darj karaee hai.
Aakhir yash maheshvari ne aisa kya kaha, jis par bihar men siyasi ghamasan mach gaya? dekhie is riport men puri khabra.
